business.name: Skill Swap
business.summary: A private team workspace for reusable AI skills and plugins. Individual contributions become shared capability through a clear library, independent review and approved releases. The promise is: Your team's know-how, ready to use. The visual identity is warm and editorial. The dimensional logo MUST be built from layered heavyweight paper or card, with broad geometric pieces, controlled folds, substantial thickness, visible edges and restrained fiber texture. Explore three distinct territories: joined modules, a folded shared object, and parts framing an open shared space.
business.audience: Teammates with mixed technical confidence, including newcomers discovering and using AI skills; Builders and trusted approvers maintain the shared library.

concept.metaphor_text: Individual contributions become a reviewed, navigable shared capability
concept.description: Two broad curved paper S letterforms rise above one shared terracotta index band. The left S is dark green and the right pale green. Their faces stay flat, with pale laminated cut edges. Two parallel scores fold the common lower band forward into a shallow stepped paper foot. One continuous paper core connects both initials and their foot. Open side cuts define the S shapes; there is no enclosing border or backing plate.

plan.hypothesis: Skill Swap initials share one index, proposing reusable team capability in a shared library

Their faces stay flat, with pale laminated cut edges. Two parallel scores fold the common lower band forward into a shallow stepped paper foot. details.feature: Shared SS core and common index
details.purpose: Use the supplied initials as a specific brand identifier while making one shared library visible
details.intended_scale: Flat, favicon, app icon and hero; broad strokes and side cuts remain the core
details.construction: Cut one paperboard blank containing both S letterforms and an uncut common bottom margin. Leave the letter faces flat. Add two straight parallel score lines only within the bottom margin, below the letterforms. Bend that margin forward at the first score and back to a parallel foot at the second score. Neither score crosses the letters or another score. The foot, margin and both letters remain one unbroken sheet; they are not glued or fitted together. Pale paper core and colored paper skins follow the same bends. The colored skin regions meet edge-to-edge: dark green on the left initial, pale green on the right and terracotta on the common folded margin. No backing panel, rigid insert or separate support is added.
details.deletion_test: Without the common bottom margin the two letterforms disconnect; without the open side cuts they cease to read as SS.

details.feature: Two scored folds in the shared index foot
details.purpose: Give the common library index a credible paper change of plane, subordinate to the initials
details.intended_scale: Hero and native detail; the same primary SS contours remain in the flat master
details.construction: Only the common bottom margin is folded. Its two scores are below the letter contours. The first score produces a short sloping panel, and the second returns the free lower edge to a plane parallel to the letter faces. Core and skins remain continuous; substantial cut edges expose the pale paper stock.
details.deletion_test: Removing the two scores loses the folded paper foot; adding a backing panel would violate the brief.
